_doc: Crop rectangles for slicing the Marriage Report asset sheet into individual PNGs.
Source sheet is 1024x1536; all coordinates are absolute pixels in that sheet.
Two section shapes:
band + outputs[] -> auto-detect N icon bounding boxes across the band (icons are
unevenly spaced, so an even grid split does not work). The
detected count MUST equal outputs.length or the run fails.
rect             -> one explicit crop, for art that touches its neighbour and
cannot be split by a dark gutter.
luma:  pixel brightness at/above which a pixel counts as content during detection.
Icons sitting on a lighter panel (highlights) need a higher value than icons
on flat black (planets).
alpha: [lo, hi] luminance ramp for background keying - at/below lo is fully
transparent, at/above hi is fully opaque, linear between. Feathered rather
than a hard cutoff so the glow around each icon does not get a jagged edge.
DELIBERATELY NOT EXTRACTED:
gemstones - public/gemstones/*.png already ships at 256x256, far better than the
~45px crops available here. Overwriting them would be a downgrade.
zodiac    - data/zodiac.ts already carries all 12 signs as Unicode glyphs, which
is what the sheet draws anyway; crisper at any size and theme-reactive.
anything with baked-in text (score badges, status pills, the label under every
icon) - the app ships 7 languages, so labels stay t() keys.

sheets._doc: Default `sheet` above is the Marriage sheet (1024x1536). A section may override it with its own `sheet`; coordinates are always absolute pixels in THAT sheet.

sections._note: Dark purple silhouette with gold line art - a steep alpha ramp keys the body away, so only true black is dropped and the silhouette stays fully opaque. Bottom edge stops above the decorative divider.
sections.name: couple

sections._note: Bright gold on flat black, so unlike the couple it takes a steep ramp that drops the background entirely - at [2,14] the near-black plate stayed opaque and read as a dark box sitting on the card.
sections.name: ring

sections._note: Kundli Milan hero: two North-Indian charts joined by a heart, the one piece of art on the all-reports sheet with no equivalent already in the repo. Cropped INSIDE the panel's gold frame (the app draws its own Card border, and a second baked-in frame reads as a box). public/reports/kundli_milan.png is untouched - it is the 44px list thumbnail, a different asset. The 6 icons below this panel are deliberately skipped: two near-identical ring variants, a gift box and a scroll, none of which map to the 8 kootas or the 8 life areas the screen actually renders.
sections.name: kundli-milan-charts

sections._note: True Love hero: dark silhouetted couple on a warm glow. alpha null - NOT keyed. Unlike marriage/couple (dark subject on near-black, where a shallow [2,14] ramp works), here the couple is the darkest thing in the crop and the background is a full warm wash, so any ramp turns the silhouettes transparent and keeps the glow. Crops to a rectangle by design; ReportHero's gradient mask is what feathers it. public/reports/true_love.png stays as the 44px list thumbnail.
sections.name: true-love-couple

sections._note: Wealth hero: kalash, gold coins, treasure chest and lotus. Bright subject, which would normally suit a steep ramp - but its background is a textured dark-warm wash rather than flat black, so keying leaves a dirty semi-opaque box AND eats the artwork's own shadowed areas. alpha null, feathered by ReportHero's gradient mask like the other two heroes. public/reports/wealth.png stays as the 44px list thumbnail (427x209, far better than this crop).
sections.name: wealth-kalash

sections._note: Career hero: silhouetted figure climbing steps toward a target. Dark subject on a lit warm background, same case as true-love/couple - alpha null, never a ramp, or the figure keys away and only the glow survives.
sections.name: career-climb

sections._note: Health hero: cyan anatomical figure with ECG traces on a dark blue technical background. Bright subject, but the background is a textured wash rather than flat black - alpha null like the other heroes.
sections.name: health-body

sections._note: Finance hero: rupee coin, calculator and pie chart on a warm dark wash. alpha null for the same reason as the rest.
sections.name: finance-rupee

sections._note: Past Life hero: figure silhouetted before a lit doorway. alpha null - the figure and arch are the dark part, exactly the true-love/couple case. NOTE the x range: panel 6 sits at 749-870, NOT 604-723, which is the Name Change panel; an earlier pass grabbed that by mistake and shipped a quill-and-scroll as the Past Life hero until a screenshot caught it.
sections.name: past-life-doorway

sections._note: Numerology hero: numeral wheel on a dark violet wash. alpha null, same reasoning as the rest of this sheet's panels.
sections.name: numerology-wheel

sections._note: Baby Name hero: sleeping baby on a crescent. alpha null.
sections.name: baby-name-moon

sections._note: Palm-reading hero: glowing hand on a lotus inside a zodiac ring. The art has small English line labels baked in, so it is used ONLY at thumbnail/hero size where they read as texture, never as functional labelling — the real per-line labels on the user's own photo are t() keys (see PalmAnnotatedView).
sections.name: palm-hero

sections._note: Sage reading a scroll - the mantras/shlokas home image. No baked text.

sections.name: om-roundel

sections._note: Progeny report hero: Yashoda holding baby Krishna, panel (row1,col2) of a fresh 6x3 Bal-Krishna/Yashoda sheet (1536x1024, landscape -- unlike the other sheets, which are 1024x1536 portrait). Columns/rows are a near-uniform 256x341 grid but individual panels' own artwork bleeds a few px past the nominal cell boundary in places (confirmed by eye, not just luminance detection -- a naive 256px-grid crop pulled in a strip of the neighbouring panel on two of these four crops), so each rect below was hand-verified against a rendered preview rather than trusted from the grid math alone.
sections.name: progeny-yashoda

sections._note: Progeny catalogue-card thumbnail (public/reports/<key>.png, the underscored-key list-thumbnail set -- a separate asset from the hero, same convention as every other report): baby Krishna with the butter pot, panel (row1,col3).
sections.name: progeny-butter

sections._note: The 35+ retrospective ChildrenCard's header image: two children watching the sunset over a river, panel (row2,col5). Needed a rect ~35px right of the naive grid boundary (x=1024) -- the true gutter for this row sits closer to x=1055.
sections.name: progeny-children

sections._note: ProgenyMantraCard's header image: baby Krishna holding a lotus, panel (row3,col2). Same rightward-shift correction as progeny-children -- this row's col1/col2 gutter also sits further right than the naive 256px grid boundary.
sections.name: progeny-lotus
